Translation by me. 

I finished this in early-mid December last year and threw up some old versions on 4chan and slowly and lazily chipped away at errors over the course of the year. I dunno if all of them have been fixed (as I haven't rigorously played every part of every game) but you should be able to get through any given game without any oddities in the text. If there are any issues, leave a comment and I'll update the file in the Mega folder.

I used Gemini to translate pretty much all of the text in batches and edited a few lines here and there if they came out sounding awkward or had incorrect names and had it edit images where I could finagle it to work, but a lot of others had to be edited with my poor skills in Photoshop. There were a few images edited before I started using Gemini, but the translations there should be fine.

There's also a mobile version, but I haven't been able to get it to work. Bluestacks and on two different phones running android 15 and 16. Maybe someone else can get it working, but I'm not really interested in updating it if it's a dud.

Edit (5/21/2026): Android version is a dud. I'll leave it up in case anyone wants it for whatever reason, but it won't be getting any potential updates.
